newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land unit signs US$400 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land unit signs US$400 mln loan.

text.p: Sino Land Investment Holding Ltd's US$400 million term loan facility was allotted and signed, arranger Peregrine Fixed Income said.

The deal is guaranteed by Sino Land Co Ltd and was completed as an unsecured transaction. It was the first time Sino Land Company Ltd or any of its subsidiaries has borrowed a substantial amount of funds without being secured by assets.
The five-year facility has a put option in year three. It pays a margin of 162.5 basis points over three-month London Interbank Offered Rate for the first three years and 185 basis points thereafter.
With fees, the all-in return is 189 basis points for top-tier managers.

Arrangers are Deutsche Bank Hong Kong, J.P.Morgan Securities Asia, Peregrine Fixed Income, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Bank of China Hong Kong, Kwangtung Provincial Bank Hong Kong, American Express Bank, and Union Bank of Hong Kong.
Co-arrangers are Toyo International Finance, Agricultural Bank of China, Hong Kong and KLB Asia Finance.
Lead managers are Fuji Bank, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Hong Kong, Shanghai Commercial Bank and Toyo Trust and Banking Hong Kong.

Senior managers are Kincheng Banking Corp Hong Kong, Malayan Banking Berhand Hong Kong, Asiana (HK) Finance, Bank of Communication, Tokyo Branch, Emirates Bank International PJSC, Hong Kong, Korean French Banking Corp -SOGEKO, and Yasuda Trust & Banking Hong Kong.
Managers are Bank of Taiwan Hong Kong, Jian Sing Bank, Banco Delta Asia, Bank of China Luxembourg and Bank of East Asia.
